escenas.texto: We toured Oceania, Asia, Africa, Europe and the Americas. Now, the ranking that brings it all together: this week's global Top 10. Thirty videos, over six hundred and fifty-six million views, and only one name at the very top of the planet. This is Top 10 Social Media, the World edition. Three countdowns: the most viewed, the most commented and the most liked videos of the week. Real numbers, from ten to one, and no spoilers until each podium. Let's go.

The rules, quick and clear. Only videos posted in the last seven days that trended around the world. One video per creator on each list. Music and news have their own space. Every number comes from the official YouTube API, measured at this week's cut-off. No guesses. Just data.

Countdown number one: the ten most viewed on the planet. The entry ticket this week: twenty million. Number ten, BullyJuice, a channel with ten point seven million subscribers, with a thirty-one second Short about washing his son's hair. Over twenty million views.

Number nine, from Colombia, Mamá recetas2.0. A two minute video with over twenty-one million views, over six hundred and eighty-one thousand likes and over four thousand comments. Latin America is on the world map.
At number eight, from South Korea, DoubleBite, with “Water vs Dried Fish”. Over twenty-two million views.
Number seven, from India, JAI HIND OFFICIAL. A twenty-five second Short, over twenty-two million views, from a channel of about one hundred and thirty-seven thousand subscribers.
At number six, from India, Facts' Mine, with “This Flying Car Mocks Elon Musk's New Tesla Roadster”. Over twenty-four million views.
Number five, Deiva Divine, with “Can Corn Really Make Beautiful Flowers?!”. Over twenty-five million views.

At number four, from the United States, Ricks Clips, with “The Ancient Jar That Warned an Empire”. Over twenty-six million views and over seven hundred and eighty-seven thousand likes, from a channel of about one hundred and seven thousand subscribers. And now, the global podium.

Bronze medal of the world: Merry Latte, with “Comment STRAW if you NEED this!”. Over thirty-six million views. A fifteen second Short, from a channel of about thirty-four thousand subscribers. The most viewed in Oceania, now on the world podium.
Silver medal of the world, from India, Shivapriya Official, with “Mango leaf decoration ideas for Diwali”. Over forty-seven million views. The most viewed in Asia. And yet, someone is still above.

Here it is. Number one most viewed on the planet: from Cyprus, Crafter Duck GARAGE, with “Making a Gold Prosthesis From Coins!”. Over eighty-two million views. Almost thirty-five million more than silver. A channel of about six hundred and nine thousand subscribers, at the top of the world.

Now, the conversation. Countdown number two: the ten most commented on the planet. And here, eleven thousand comments are just the entry ticket. Number ten, from Mexico, FedeGames, with a fourteen minute video. Over eleven thousand comments.

Number nine, from the United States, Dream, thirty-four point eight million subscribers, with “Minecraft Speedrunner VS 6 Hunters FINALE”. Forty-nine minutes, over ten million views and over twelve thousand comments.
At number eight, the Arabic-language channel Lana and Roro, with an eighteen minute video. Over twelve thousand comments, on just over six hundred and seventy-two thousand views.
Number seven, Mob Entertainment, with “What's the time?”. A forty-two second Short, over thirteen thousand comments.

At number six, from Turkey, Vural Üzül, with a forty-nine minute video. Over fourteen thousand comments, on just over two hundred and eighteen thousand views. The most talkative audience in this countdown.
Number five, from the United States, Mindova, with “Grandpa's Magic Made Millions Smile”. Sixteen seconds, over sixteen million views and over seventeen thousand comments.
At number four, Zack D. Films, with “Could You Move Mount Everest To America?”. Over twenty thousand comments. And from here, the podium.
Bronze medal in comments, from Indonesia, Dhot Design, with part five of “Aku Masih Di Sini”. Over twenty-three thousand comments. The most commented in Asia, now on the world podium.
Silver medal, from Germany, Dhruv Rathee, with “How Indian Media BRAINWASHES You!”. Over twenty-four thousand comments. The most commented in Europe. But number one went even further.

Number one most commented on the planet: from Brazil, Mundo Torajo, with a three minute video. Over thirty-one thousand comments, on over six point eight million views. Thirty-one thousand voices, the loudest comment section in the world this week.
And the final countdown: the ten most liked on the planet. Number ten, from Germany, Dhruv Rathee, again. Over four hundred and seventy-six thousand likes.

Number nine, from the United States, Conexwest, with a two minute tour of a shipping container home. Over four hundred and eighty-one thousand likes, from a channel of about eighty-three thousand subscribers.
At number eight, Eyser, with a one minute clip from the film Fist Fight. Over five hundred and eleven thousand likes.
Number seven, from the United States, Sean Andrew, with “I Tested the Famous Pirate Eye Patch Myth!”. Over five hundred and seventeen thousand likes.
At number six, from Colombia, Mamá recetas2.0. Over six hundred and eighty-one thousand likes.
Number five, from India, Facts' Mine, with the flying car. Over six hundred and eighty-five thousand likes.
At number four, from Indonesia, isonkeh, with a thirty-three second Short. Over seven hundred and thirty thousand likes. And now, the last podium of the tour.
Bronze medal in likes, from the United States, Ricks Clips, with the ancient jar. Over seven hundred and eighty-seven thousand likes.
Silver medal, Zack D. Films, with “Why ChatGPT Contradicted Itself”. Over nine hundred and eight thousand likes. So close to a million. But someone crossed that line.

Number one most liked on the planet: from Cyprus, Crafter Duck GARAGE, with the gold prosthesis made from coins. Over one million likes. Number one in views, number one in likes. The king of Europe is the king of the world this week.

And that wraps up this week's world tour. Now it's your turn: which video should have made this countdown? Tell us in the comments with the hashtag Top10RS. Links to every original video are in the description: go support the creators. Subscribe and hit the bell. A new Top 10 every Sunday.
